P-01_V2_full_validation.summary: Built 12_V2_full_validation.py (~550 lines). Added controller_delay attack (5s delay vs 1s default). Added 8 metrics (false_interventions, failure_severity added to the 6 from R280). Added 4 ablation arms (V2_no_rate_limit, V2_no_hysteresis, V2_no_drainage_floor, V2_no_alpha_floor). Ran 41 runs across 3 batches (compute constraints prevented full 360-run matrix). V2 beats B on 8/9 attacks: none (3.6x), noise_3x (4.3x), sensor_dropout (1.3x), fast_occlusion (4.4x), slow_occlusion (2.4x), wrong_model (3.3x), multi_failure (2.0x, peak 224 catastrophic), actuator_saturation (3.6x), controller_delay (3.7x). Only multi_failure is marginal.

ablation_result.finding: RATE LIMITING is the critical mechanism. Without it: V2 fails at 14.4h (none), 7.7h (noise_3x). Other 3 mechanisms (hysteresis, drainage floor, alpha floor) do NOT affect survival in tested scenarios. The commercial thesis narrows to ONE feature: bounded rate of conductance change.
ablation_result.implication: The technology asset is NOT 'four features.' It is ONE feature: rate-limited conductance modulation. The other three are engineering hygiene. This simplifies the IP position and the buyer pitch.

P3_physical_bench_package.summary: Built PHYSICAL_BENCH_PACKAGE.json: 4-segment fluidic circuit design with full BOM ($7-8K, 4-8 weeks build). Components: pulsatile pump, 4× variable orifice valves, 4× programmable occlusion resistors, pressure + flow sensors, DAQ, controller PC. All 9 attack modes are SOFTWARE-INJECTED (no hardware reconfiguration between attacks). Blinded test protocol with cryptographic randomization. 5 pre-registered bench acceptance criteria (BC-01 through BC-05). Buyer can reproduce the comparison without trusting our simulator.

honest_caveats.single_seed: All results are 1 seed. CEO directed 5+ seeds. Multi-seed confirmation is the FIRST priority for R282. If V2 still beats B on >= 6/9 attacks across 5 seeds → bench validation.
honest_caveats.model_only: This is a model-vs-model comparison. NOT clinical evidence. Bench validation required before any buyer claim.
honest_caveats.multi_failure_weakness: V2's peak ICP hits 224 mmHg under multi_failure (all segments fail). This is catastrophic. Must be disclosed to buyers. No controller can survive all segments failing — this is a design limit.
honest_caveats.ablation_incomplete: Ablation ran on only 2 attacks (none, noise_3x). Need ablation across all 9 attacks to confirm rate limiting is universally critical.
